description: Converts a PDF to Markdown (headings, lists, tables) with PyMuPDF and extracts every embedded image as a separate file. Output: document.md (images referenced as images/NNN.ext) and images/*.

minImageSize.description: Skip images smaller than this many pixels on their short side (default 64; drops icons and rules).

pages.description: Page range such as 1-5 (1-based). Default: all pages.
